title: Rule
description: A declarative priority or routing rule, scoped to an Agency. Grounding: LBT held-out priority-RTT tiering kept all 159 real events and bottomed 164 of 1068 (15.4 pct).

when.description: Predicate over an incoming event. Interpreter is out of scope for this ontology; JSON-Logic or a SPARQL-like DSL are both reasonable.

detail.description: Action-specific payload. For tier-shift: {from, to}. For notify: {recipientId}. For annotate: {tag}.
